runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
M-25-22 starts applying to new AI contracts **180 days after the memorandum is issued**. It covers contract awards that follow solicitations released from that date onward, and renewals or extensions exercised on existing contracts after that date as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

The memo does not reach AI bought as a component of a national security system This memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.

Separately, agencies have a longer deadline for internal changes: Within 270 days of the issuance of this memorandum, agencies must revisit, and update where necessary, existing internal procedures on acquisition to comply with the requirements of this memorandum.
